header: Two designers, one desk, one freight dispatch app
lead: Ana Marques and Tomás Ferreira took a single job in March 2016: redraw the dispatch screen that Northwind Logistics controllers hated. It ran nine weeks, it cut handling time from 6.5 minutes to 2.4, and it paid for the second desk.
body: Ten years later the studio is 24 people across three cities, and the method has barely moved. We sit with the people who will use the thing, draw it badly, test it on a Thursday, and draw it again. When an engagement ends the client keeps the research recordings, the component files and every prototype, because the alternative is a business model we decided against.
